title: Harden Core Runtime Version Contracts
stopConditions: Project Control cannot identify the Work path, owner repository, active role, checklist target, and evidence target before Core product edits.
Core product behavior would be edited before reading the Core repository AGENTS.md in a dedicated Core worktree.
A version-surface deletion target cannot be proven unused or classified as retained for migration, retained for evidence, or blocked.
Backend compatibility would be changed or claimed without a Core-owned public contract and fresh consumer-boundary evidence.
The lane would promote broad Core, Backend, or FlowDoc truth from a narrow runtime-version hardening result.
verificationTarget: Core worktree evidence proves the runtime version contract, migration and mutation behavior, public consumer boundary, and retirement inventory; Project Control records the bounded result without broad Node truth promotion.
summary: Begin the Core runtime version contract hardening phase with an explicit cleanup and retirement inventory gate before Backend hardening.
